Hexify Complete Rewrite Plan

Source: REWRITE_PLAN.md

Goal: MIT-licensed rewrite with modern coding practices, clean architecture, and clear naming.

Guiding Principles: 1. Self-documenting code over comments 2. One responsibility per function/file 3. No single-letter variables (except loop indices) 4. Descriptive names that don’t require domain knowledge 5. Maximum nesting depth of 2 6. Early returns over nested conditionals

Part 1: Naming Convention Standards

Variables

Old New Rationale
tx, ty triangle_x, triangle_y Clear coordinate system
azh, azh0, azh1 azimuth, azimuth_original, azimuth_reduced Descriptive suffixes
dazh face_azimuth_offset What it actually represents
rho radial_distance Standard term, spelled out
GH, DH SNYDER_G_ANGLE, SNYDER_D_ANGLE Reference Snyder’s paper
cent_lon, cent_lat center_lon, center_lat Consistent spelling
px, py plane_x, plane_y Clear coordinate system
z great_circle_dist What it measures
n count, num_points, etc. Context-specific
i, j cell_i, cell_j (when cell indices) Disambiguate from loop vars
q, r, s cube_q, cube_r, cube_s Cube coordinate system
tnum triangle_index Clear meaning
quad quad_index Clear meaning

Rotation Classes

Old New Rationale
classI ROTATION_CLASS_1 Readable, no ambiguous roman numerals
classII ROTATION_CLASS_2 Consistent
classIII_A, classIII_B ROTATION_CLASS_3A, ROTATION_CLASS_3B Clear variants
flip_classes alternate_rotation Describes the behavior

Functions

Old New Rationale
sllxy() project_to_face_plane() What it does
gc_dist() great_circle_distance() Spell it out
coordtrans() transform_spherical_coords() Clear purpose
which_face() find_containing_face() Action-oriented
cpp_hex_index_z3_* aperture3_index_* Aperture, not curve type
z3_quantize aperture3_quantize User-facing name
z7_quantize aperture7_quantize Consistent
hex_* (R functions) hexify_* Package prefix
dg* (R functions) Keep for compat, deprecate dggridR compatibility

Part 2: Glossary of Terms

Create GLOSSARY.md with:

# DGGS Terminology

## Coordinate Systems

### PROJTRI (Projected Triangle)
- `(triangle_index, triangle_x, triangle_y)`
- Output of Snyder forward projection
- triangle_index: 0-19 (icosahedron faces)
- triangle_x, triangle_y: normalized [0,1] within face

### Q2DD (Quad 2D Double)
- `(quad_index, x, y)` with floating-point x,y
- Intermediate representation after triangle-to-quad conversion
- quad_index: 0-11 (pairs of triangles forming rhombuses)

### Q2DI (Quad 2D Integer)
- `(quad_index, cell_i, cell_j)` with integer indices
- Final cell identification at a given resolution
- Used by DGGRID for cell assignment

### SEQNUM (Sequential Number)
- Single integer uniquely identifying each cell globally
- Formula: `face * cells_per_face + local_index`
- Useful for database storage and indexing

## Projection Terms

### Snyder Projection
Equal-area projection from sphere to icosahedron faces.
- Forward: (lon, lat) → (triangle_index, triangle_x, triangle_y)
- Inverse: (triangle_index, triangle_x, triangle_y) → (lon, lat)

### Face Azimuth Offset
Per-face rotation angle to align projection with icosahedron orientation.
Variable: `face_azimuth_offset` (previously `dazh`)

## Grid Terms

### Aperture
Ratio of cell areas between successive resolution levels.
- Aperture 3: Each parent contains ~3 children (1:√3 linear scale)
- Aperture 4: Each parent contains 4 children (1:2 linear scale)
- Aperture 7: Each parent contains ~7 children (1:√7 linear scale)

### Rotation Class
Orientation of hexagons at each resolution level.
- Class 1: Flat-top orientation (vertex pointing up)
- Class 2: Pointy-top orientation (edge pointing up)
- Class 3A/3B: Intermediate orientations (aperture 7 only)

### Effective Resolution
Resolution level accounting for aperture effects.
Higher = smaller cells, more cells globally.

### Surrogate Grid
Fine-resolution grid used to approximate non-Class-1 cell positions.
Used internally for Class 2 and Class 3 quantization.

Part 3: C++ Layer Restructure

3.1 Consolidate Aperture Code

Current: 3 separate files with duplicated patterns - hex_ap3.cpp (87 lines) - hex_ap4.cpp (67 lines) - hex_ap7.cpp (84 lines)

New: Template-based approach in aperture_grid.h/cpp

// aperture_grid.h
namespace hexify {

enum class Aperture { AP3 = 3, AP4 = 4, AP7 = 7 };

struct GridConfig {
    Aperture aperture;
    int resolution;
    RotationClass rotation_class;  // Computed from aperture + resolution
    double scale_factor;           // √3, 2, or √7
};

// Unified interface
CellCoord quantize_to_cell(double triangle_x, double triangle_y,
                           const GridConfig& config);

Point2D cell_center(const CellCoord& cell, const GridConfig& config);

std::array<Point2D, 6> cell_corners(const CellCoord& cell,
                                     const GridConfig& config);
}

3.2 Unify Space-Filling Curves

Current: 3 separate implementations - hex_index_z3.cpp (183 lines) - hex_index_z7.cpp (399 lines) - hex_index_zorder.cpp (176 lines)

New: Strategy pattern in cell_indexing.h/cpp

// cell_indexing.h
namespace hexify {

class CellIndex {
public:
    static CellIndex from_cell(const CellCoord& cell, Aperture aperture);
    static CellIndex from_string(const std::string& index_str);

    CellCoord to_cell() const;
    std::string to_string() const;
    uint64_t to_integer() const;

    CellIndex parent() const;
    std::vector<CellIndex> children() const;

private:
    Aperture aperture_;
    std::vector<int> digits_;  // Base 3, 4, or 7 depending on aperture
};
}

3.3 Simplify Coordinate Transforms

Current: tri_to_q2di.cpp (1,060 lines) - monolithic

New: Split into logical units

coordinate_transforms/
├── triangle_to_quad.cpp      (~200 lines) - PROJTRI → Q2DD
├── quad_to_integer.cpp       (~200 lines) - Q2DD → Q2DI
├── integer_to_seqnum.cpp     (~150 lines) - Q2DI → SEQNUM
├── transform_tables.cpp      (~100 lines) - Pre-computed lookup tables
└── coordinate_transforms.h   (~80 lines)  - Public interface

Part 4: R Layer Restructure

4.1 Function Naming

Deprecate immediately (with warnings): - hex_map() → hexify_map() - hex_heatmap() → hexify_heatmap() - hex_plot() → hexify_plot() - hex_assign() → hexify_assign() - hex_to_polygons() → hexify_to_polygons()

Keep for dggridR compatibility (with deprecation warnings): - dgconstruct() → hexify_construct() (recommend new name) - dgGEO_to_SEQNUM() → hexify_lonlat_to_seqnum() - dgSEQNUM_to_GEO() → hexify_seqnum_to_lonlat() - etc.

4.2 New R File Structure

R/
├── hexify-package.R           # Package declaration
├── hexify.R                   # Main entry point: hexify()
├── construct.R                # hexify_construct(), grid specification
├── assign.R                   # hexify_assign(), point-to-cell
├── conversions.R              # lon/lat ↔ cell ↔ seqnum
├── indexing.R                 # Space-filling curve operations
├── polygons.R                 # Polygon generation
├── visualization.R            # hexify_map(), hexify_heatmap(), hexify_plot()
├── projection.R               # Low-level projection wrappers
├── stats.R                    # Grid statistics
├── compat_dggrid.R            # dggridR compatibility layer (deprecated)
├── constants.R                # Package constants
├── utils.R                    # Internal utilities
└── data.R                     # Dataset documentation

4.3 API Cleanup

Remove internal functions from exports: - project_and_quantize() - compute_cell_center() - make_cell_id() - build_hex_polygon()

Consolidate similar functions: - hexify_lonlat_to_cell() and hexify_assign() have overlapping purposes - Keep hexify() as the main entry, hexify_assign() for advanced use

Part 5: Implementation Phases

Phase 1: Naming & Documentation (Low Risk)

  1. Create GLOSSARY.md
  2. Rename classI/II/III → ROTATION_CLASS_1/2/3 in C++
  3. Rename internal variables (dazh → face_azimuth_offset, etc.)
  4. Add deprecation warnings to hex_* R functions
  5. Update all roxygen documentation

Phase 2: C++ Consolidation (Medium Risk)

  1. Create aperture_grid.cpp/h with unified interface
  2. Migrate hex_ap3/4/7.cpp to new structure
  3. Update Rcpp bindings
  4. Run full test suite after each file

Phase 3: Coordinate System Cleanup (Medium Risk)

  1. Split tri_to_q2di.cpp into logical units
  2. Rename files to descriptive names
  3. Add comprehensive documentation

Phase 4: R Layer Cleanup (Low Risk)

  1. Rename R files
  2. Consolidate similar functions
  3. Update all examples and vignettes

Phase 5: Index Unification (Higher Risk)

  1. Create unified CellIndex class
  2. Migrate hex_index_z3/z7/zorder.cpp
  3. Extensive testing - this is complex

Part 6: Testing Strategy

Preserve All Existing Tests

  • Tests encode ground truth behavior
  • Rename test files to match new source files
  • Keep dggridR reference tests as validation

Add New Tests

  • Test deprecated function warnings
  • Test new unified interfaces
  • Property-based tests for round-trips

Continuous Validation

  • Run devtools::test() after every file change
  • All 7383 tests must pass at each step
  • No behavior changes allowed (pure refactor)

Part 7: Migration Path for Users

v0.3.0 (This Release)

  • Add deprecation warnings to old names
  • Document new naming convention
  • All functionality unchanged

v0.4.0 (Future)

  • Remove deprecated hex_* functions
  • Remove deprecated dg* functions (or move to separate compat package)
  • Clean API surface
